item.title: The Sonoma County Fair — Fri Aug 14, 10:00 AM — Sonoma County Fairgrounds
item.description:
A celebration of community spirit, agriculture, entertainment, and wholesome fun.
The Sonoma County Fair is an annual event that captivates visitors with its vibrant atmosphere and diverse offerings. Held in scenic Sonoma County, California, this fair is a celebration of community spirit, agriculture, entertainment, and wholesome fun. From thrilling amusement rides and live music performances to engaging exhibits showcasing local produce, crafts, and artwork, the fair offers something for everyone. Attendees can indulge in mouthwatering fair food, participate in thrilling competitions, enjoy live animal exhibits, and explore the region’s rich agricultural heritage. With its charming blend of entertainment and education, the Sonoma County Fair is a must-visit destination that brings joy and excitement to people of all ages.
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: SUP Yoga on the Petaluma River — Fri Aug 14, 6:00 PM — The Floathouse Petaluma
item.description: This is SUP Yoga the Petaluma way—right downtown, deeply local, and rooted in our river. SUP Yoga at The Floathouse Petaluma invites locals to slow down and experience the Petaluma River as part of everyday life. Though we launch from the heart of downtown, the central turning basin holds a special calm. Once you’re on the water, the noise drops away and the river becomes what many of us love most about Petaluma: peaceful, welcoming, and shared. Sessions are gentle and all-levels, designed for neighbors as much as newcomers. We begin with a short, easy paddle from the docks to get comfortable on your board (knees are always welcome), then anchor together so tidal movement won’t interrupt your flow. From there, you’re free to move, stretch, breathe, rest—or simply float—guided by expert instruction and supported by community. item.title: Broadway Under the Stars - Mamma Mia! — Fri Aug 14, 7:00 PM — Sonoma Valley Field of Dreams
item.description:
The global smash hit is coming to Sonoma for the very first time! Set on a sun-drenched Greek island, Mamma Mia! follows a young bride-to-be on a quest to discover the identity of her father — bringing three very unexpected guests from her mother’s past back into their lives. Fueled by ABBA’s greatest hits (including “Dancing Queen,” “Mamma Mia,” “The Winner Takes It All,” and more), this joyful tale of family, friendship, love, and second chances has captured the hearts of millions worldwide. With its large cast, explosive dance numbers, nonstop humor, and irresistible score, Mamma Mia! promises to be one of the biggest and most unforgettable productions in Transcendence history. Mamma Mia! is presented through special arrangement with Music Theatre International (MTI). All authorized performance materials are also supplied by MTI. www.mtishows.com
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.description: Discover your family story at our Family Search Center You will find our center in the Lakeport building in the room next to the nursery. item.title: Linocut Stamp Carving Workshop — Sat Sep 5, 10:30 AM — Sonoma Botanical Garden
item.description:
Discover the creative art of linocut printmaking with Bay Area artist Ana Bianchi in this hands-on workshop designed for beginners and curious makers alike.
You’ll learn the fundamentals of stamp carving and relief printing while exploring pattern, imagery, and repeatable design through playful experimentation. Beginning with an easy-to-carve white eraser before progressing to professional rubber carving blocks, participants will gain confidence using carving tools, safely handling materials, and understanding the unique reverse-image process of printmaking.
Saturday, September 5, 10:30 a.m. – 1:30 p.m.
$78 for members, $95 for non-members | Includes Garden admission. Please check in at the Center for Learning & Engagement. To learn more and sign up, click “Register” and explore the “Info” tab on the registration page.

item.title: The Brandlin Estate Wine & Food Tasting Experience — Fri Sep 11, 11:00 AM — Brandlin Estate
item.description:
Born on the rugged slopes of Mount Veeder, Brandlin Estate produces wines of structure, intensity, and place. The Brandlin Experience offers an in-depth exploration of this historic vineyard site through a curated tasting of five estate-grown wines—including Zinfandel from century-old vines and the estate’s signature Cabernet Sauvignon. This seated, guided experience invites guests to delve into the mountain terroir through the lens of small-lot winemaking. Each wine reflects the elevation, exposure, and rocky soils that define the Brandlin Estate. For an added dimension, guests may opt to include seasonal bites, thoughtfully paired to complement the structure and complexity of the wines. This experience is hosted at the picturesque Boathouse.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: Collector’s Lunch Pairing at Lynmar Estate — Fri Sep 11, 12:30 PM — Lynmar Estate
item.description:

item.title: Capo Creek Harvest Celebration — Sat Sep 12, 5:00 AM — Capo Creek Winery
item.description:
This is a fantastic 2 day event so be sure to order the COMBO ticket to get the best overall experience. The weekend starts with a Friday (Sept 11) welcome reception with food & wine at which time instructions and supplies for grape picking will be distributed. At 5:00am the grape pick begins as daylight breaks, followed by our annual champagne breakfast at dawn while processing & stomping grapes. After breaking for personal time, the celebration continues with Harvest Dinner Saturday at 5:00pm. The theme this year is **Out of This World**... think space, astronauts, aliens, the future. Dress up is not mandatory but way more fun if you do. Prizes are awarded for character representation so joining in on the fun is encouraged. Ticket options include a HARVEST DINNER option without the winery experience.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: Joe Melendrez — Sat Sep 12, 8:00 AM — Six Flags Discovery Kingdom
item.description:

Later that year, on a Teen A.C.T.S. Retreat, Joe encountered the awesome love of God. It was then that he decided to dedicate his life to sharing the Good News. Joe shares the Gospel in many unique ways, from his development of a faith-based clothing line \(God Swagg Apparel\), his release of four major Catholic hip-hop albums, to sharing the winnings from a college Chipotle contest \(a year of free burritos\), as a means to evangelize to different people with each meal!
Joe’s BA in Religious studies from the University of Dayton has led him to become a Religion Teacher and Youth Minister for over 10 years. item.title: Medic First Aid CPR and AED Training — Sat Sep 12, 8:30 AM — Petaluma Valley Hospital
item.description:
Course Description: This course goes a step beyond basic CPR. In this four-hour class, students will learn information and skills to provide effective emergency care to an injured or ill person before first responders arrive. The workplace is the focus, using industrial and office settings for the scenario-based learning environment. CPR, plus other lifesaving skills including bleeding control, choke saving, hazardous conditions awareness, and an introduction to the AED. Each students receives a manual, instruction, mannequin use and Medic First Aid card valid for two years. Course Audience: The class-of-choice for non-medical people, this class is the perfect course for any individual who would like to be prepared to respond to a cardiac emergency, anytime and anywhere. Great for on-site training for employees who have a duty to respond to a cardiac emergency due to job responsibilities or regulatory requirements.
Source: North Bay Bohemian
